name: Kashiwagi Benio
source: Comic Bottom's Chief Editor. At first she was supposed to be the Chief Editor of a gossip magazine, but was voted to be the next Chief Editor for Comic Bottom instead. Due to this, she has no motivation to make sure that the magazine will be a succesful one.
